notes: The shell's eight-point section falls to zero thickness at both side edges and peaks at a centre ridge. Below the measured base it contracts through two mirrored slopes (80 -> 52 -> 26 -> 18 half-width) into a neck seated inside the central socket. The insert's six-point section keeps square sides and takes no bevel.

Root taper and capped outer end both cut. The shell's new neck is narrow enough that the rods clear it on their own: the upper rod's innermost point is at |X|=40 where the neck is 26 wide, so no rod passes through the crystal.
Jaws faceted to four planes, half-depth 9, straddling the gem in Z at +17 against the gem's +19. They cradle without intersecting.
Connector arms are six-sided wrapped limbs rather than boxes, half-width 15-17. Each spinner end runs radius 5 at the neck, 18 at the bulge, then a point over 50 units.

Four-sided bipyramid, 84 tall by 34 wide, front vertex 11 proud of the waist. Its Z stack was pulled in from +30 to +19 because at the old depth the front vertex reached Z=45 against a 13-deep blade and read as bolted onto the front.

Grip holds half-width 12 from the guard connection to the collar. All three protruding ring meshes are gone; the wrap is vertex-colour banding on the same shaft. One collar at Y=-166..-180, then an independent pommel with maximum radius 11.
